sloka: स्वयं रक्षोधिपश्चापि पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः ।मृतेति संयुगे मुक्तो रामेणादित्यतेजसा ।। ६.६०.७७ ।।।।
transliteration: svayaṁ rakṣodhipaścāpi paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ ।mṛteti saṁyuge mukto rāmeṇādityatejasā ।। 6.60.77 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the words of Yupaksha, regarding the insult of his brother Kumbhakarna said this rolling his eyes.
